description: This file defines the class WeightPackageSessionLine, which models a line item in a shipment weight package, including properties like weight, dimensions, and shipment identifiers, along with methods to manipulate and apply these properties within a shipment processing context.

classes.name: WeightPackageSessionLine
classes.description: A serializable class representing a shipment weight package line with properties for dimensions, weight, shipment IDs, and methods to apply the line to a shipment package.

methods.name: WeightPackageSessionLine
methods.description: Constructor initializing the shipment line with order ID, weight, dimensions, box type, and sequence ID.

methods.name: getOrderId
methods.description: Returns the order ID associated with this shipment line.

methods.name: setOrderId
methods.description: Sets the order ID for this shipment line.

methods.name: getPackageWeight
methods.description: Returns the weight of the package.

methods.name: setPackageWeight
methods.description: Sets the weight of the package.

methods.name: getPackageLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the package.

methods.name: setPackageLength
methods.description: Sets the length of the package.

methods.name: getPackageWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the package.

methods.name: setPackageWidth
methods.description: Sets the width of the package.

methods.name: getPackageHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the package.

methods.name: setPackageHeight
methods.description: Sets the height of the package.

methods.name: getShipmentBoxTypeId
methods.description: Returns the shipment box type ID.

methods.name: setShipmentBoxTypeId
methods.description: Sets the shipment box type ID.

methods.name: getWeightPackageSeqId
methods.description: Returns the sequence ID of the weight package.

methods.name: setWeightPackageSeqId
methods.description: Sets the sequence ID of the weight package.

methods.name: getShipmentItemSeqId
methods.description: Returns the shipment item sequence ID.

methods.name: setShipmentItemSeqId
methods.description: Sets the shipment item sequence ID.

methods.name: applyLineToPackage
methods.description: Applies this shipment line to a shipment package by invoking a service to add shipment content, handling errors accordingly.
